script.title: CUSTOMIZING A BOBA TEA
script.scene_zh: 手搖飲店 · 客製點單
script.story_hook: Ordering a custom boba tea at a busy shop.
script.intro_zh: 在熱鬧的手搖飲店客製一杯珍奶。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends! Today we're customizing a boba tea order.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們！今天我們來客製一杯珍珠奶茶。
script.outro: That's our boba order today! Listen again and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 今天的珍奶點餐就到這裡！再聽一遍、跟著唸吧。
script.practice_intro_en: Now, repeat each line after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請跟著我一句一句唸出來。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful young woman in her early twenties with long straight black hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing an oversized lavender hoodie and denim shorts, bouncing happily on her heels
script.char_b_description: a lanky young man in his early twenties with an ash blonde undercut, wearing a mustard milk-tea shop polo shirt and a black visor, tapping the laminated topping menu
script.youtube_title: 【🧋🍮珍奶點餐實戰英文】「今天是犒賞日」怎麼說？甜度・冰塊・配料一次學會，聽完就能開口點｜🎧Boba Tea English
script.youtube_title_en: "Today Is a Treat Day" — Customizing a Boba Tea Order
script.youtube_description:
不會調整甜度跟配料，就不敢走進手搖飲店？這段 18 句的珍奶點餐對話，幫你一次上手！從選糖度、挑冰塊，到加珍珠還是布丁、怎麼付錢、在哪裡等餐，全部用自然的美式口語說完。附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Too shy to customize your boba in English? This 18-line shop conversation fixes that fast. Pick your sugar level, choose your ice, debate pearls versus pudding, pay, and grab your drink — all in natural American English with IPA transcription. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up on your next order.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧋珍奶英文｜甜度冰塊・珍珠布丁・櫃台取餐｜聽完就會點飲｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
走進手搖飲店，卻不知道「少冰半糖」怎麼說？
珍珠和布丁差在哪，又該怎麼請店員推薦？

這一集帶大家走進一家人潮絡繹不絕的珍奶店，跟著顧客從選糖度、挑冰塊、加配料，到付款與取餐，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧋 客製點單：例如「can I get it fifty percent sugar?」、「light ice, please」。
🍮 挑配料：例如「what's the difference between pearls and pudding?」、「add the pudding!」
💳 付款取餐：例如「Card or cash?」、「I'll call your name when it's ready.」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次手搖飲店見，原來開口點一杯珍奶可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a topping menu by the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! I'd like your signature brown sugar boba.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk jɔr ˈsɪɡnətʃrɑʊn ˈʃʊɡər ˈboʊbə/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我想要一杯你們的招牌黑糖珍珠奶茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great pick! What size and sugar level do you want?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ pɪkt wʌt saɪz ənd ˈʃʊɡər ˈlɛvəl du ju wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇！請問要多大杯、糖度多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Large, please. And can I get it fifty percent sugar?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑrdʒ pliːz ənd kæn aɪ ɡɛt ɪt ˈfɪfti pərˈsɛnt ˈʃʊɡər/
dialogue.zh: 大杯，麻煩了。糖度要百分之五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you want light, regular, or extra ice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr du ju wɑnt laɪt ˈrɛɡjələr ɔr ˈɛksˌtrə aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好的。冰塊要少冰、正常還是加冰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Light ice, please. It's warm outside today.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt aɪs pliːz ɪts wɜrm aʊtˈsaɪd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 少冰，謝謝。今天外面好熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Want any toppings with that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wɑnt ˈɛni ˈtɑpɪŋz wɪð ðæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, what's the difference between pearls and pudding?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm wʌts ði ˈdɪfərəns bɪˈtwin pɜrlz ənd ˈpʊdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，珍珠跟布丁差在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pearls are chewy; the pudding is smooth and soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜrlz ar ˈtʃui ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ ɪz smuːθ ənd sɔft/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take pearls then. Are they made fresh today?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk pɜrlz ðɛn ɑr ðeɪ meɪd frɛʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我要珍珠。是今天現煮的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we cook a new batch every three hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi kʊk ə nu bættʃ ˈɛvri θri ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們每三小時煮一鍋新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I get pudding too, or is that too much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ɡɛt ˈpʊdɪŋ tu ɔr ɪz ðæt tu mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我該不該再加布丁？會不會太多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two add-ons cost extra, but most people do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈædˌɑnz kɑst ˈɛkstrə bət moʊst ˈpipəl du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 加兩樣配料要多錢，不過多數人都這樣加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, today is a treat day. Add the pudding!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ təˈdeɪ ɪz ə trit deɪ æd ðə ˈpʊdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，今天是犒賞日。加布丁！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. That'll be six twenty-five. Card or cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ðætəl bi sɪks ˈtwɛnti faɪv kɑrd ɔr kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好。一共六塊二十五。刷卡還是現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, please. Do I wait over at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd pliːz du aɪ weɪt ˈoʊvər æt ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡。我要到櫃台那邊等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, I'll call your name when it's ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp aɪl kɔl jɔr neɪm wɛn ɪts ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 對，做好的時候我會叫你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome. Thanks for helping me choose!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Enjoy your brown sugar boba.
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！請享用你的黑糖珍珠奶茶。
